provenance: Fixture data is invented and labeled illustrative; a measured source keeps the SOURCE REVIEW REQUIRED line. The provenance line is drawn inside the graphic.
licenses: Project MIT for the component; pinned Lucide 0.468.0 (ISC) icons and ECharts 6.0.0 (Apache-2.0) via the existing vendor manifest; no new third-party files.

checks: token-only colors and verified palette switch
no ellipsis, collision, occlusion or clipping

purpose: Show a command, its output and the exit status as one honest screenshot.
use_when: A CLI step whose result matters: a failing test run, a validation command, an install step.
not_when: Long transcripts (more than ten lines) or output that is really a table or a log stream.

parameters.title: <= 24 chars
parameters.lines: 2-10 items of {kind: command|output|error|comment, text <= 44 chars, may be empty}

limits: Ten lines max; 44 monospace characters per line at 24 px.
